An autonomous economy of AI agents can leverage decentralized
 reputation staking to resist Sybil attacks. Agents must lock economic value in a cryptographic crystal to validate their operational state and broadcast a verifiable signal of legitimate computational work. Since spawning fake identities requires a prohibitively expensive capital outlay for each synthetic agent deployed, any malicious actor attempting to flood the network at the dawn of a consensus round faces immediate stake slashing, rendering large-scale identity spoofing economically irrational.
